reasoning_traces.think:
The engine operates in six stages: ratings → fair line → distribution → CDF → ladder rungs → vig application. The core kernel assumes a normal distribution, mapping spread probabilities via Φ((μ − x)/σ). This is validated by a clean local linear fit with low RMSE. Ladder generation is deterministic, enforcing monotonicity and spacing rules from the CDF. Vig application introduces asymmetry, with Pinnacle applying tighter spreads (1.4 pp) and loading close games, while DK applies uniform rake tilted toward public bias. The model’s failure mode arises when σ varies or skewness appears in tails, invalidating the normality assumption. Dualities emerge in how each book’s policy reflects distinct risk-load strategies, with Pinnacle underpricing longshots and DK balancing public sentiment.
